```sql
SELECT
  locations.location_id AS location_id,
  locations.location_name AS location_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_items.is_food_item THEN order_items.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS food_revenue
FROM dev.order_items AS order_items
JOIN dev.orders AS orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
JOIN dev.locations AS locations ON orders.location_id = locations.location_id
GROUP BY locations.location_id, locations.location_name
ORDER BY food_revenue DESC
```
